difficulty_reason: An on-diagonal Weyl estimate alone loses the quadratic separation factor for points arbitrarily closer than one wavelength. The complete Appendix supplies the required differentiated spectral asymptotic from the named analytic foundations, so the source-specific scale control remains an obligation rather than a direct use of a continuity theorem.
